Form No. 2
G. 25,000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Cr. & Sp. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 755
Date April 21. 1932.
Date 21/4/32.

Subject (in full)....................................re. Application for a Pistol....................................

Made by Russ...Translator..Pokrovsky Forwarded by....................................(Initials).

Sir,
With reference to my application for permission to
purchase a pistol which has been overruled, I beg leave to
bring to your notice the fact that in my application I have
not made it clear to you the motive that prompted me to take
such steps.
May I tresspass on your generosity once again to
reconsider your decision on the ground that, in putting forward
the application, I had no intentions other than that of
procuring a pistol for self-protection. Incidentally, my
house was broken into a few days ago when a sum of money
was stolen and prior to this incident several attempts had
been made to break into the house. Now that I am married
I feel it is my duty to accord my wife some sense of security
because she has been terrified ever since the recent theft.
Trusting that you will be so good as to give the
matter your favourable consideration,
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant
N. S. Pokrovsky
Russian Translator.

（左侧批注：This needs 95% attention to do. earnestly / For upwards / 2 atm / 21/4/32）

S.A.(CIB)
Mr Pokrovsky has no pistol; the Police
cannot sell him one. The fact that
his house was broken into does not mean
that he should have a pistol to shoot thieves
as his work is not dangerous & Cannot
Differ from others. There are thousands of foreigners
without pistols in Shanghai
Stayers
21/4/32
DC (or)

C 5
please inform Mr Pokrovsky
Noted. N.S. Pokrovsky
21/4/32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 755
日期 1932年4月21日。
日期 1932年4月21日。

事由（全称）____ 关于申请手枪执照 ____ 

申请人 俄籍翻译员 Pokrovsky 转呈人 ____ （首字母）。

先生：
鉴于我此前申请购买手枪之许可已被驳回，谨提请阁下注意，我在该申请中并未向阁下清楚阐明促使我采取此举的动机。
恳请阁下再次惠予 reconsideration（重新考虑），基于以下理由：我在提出申请时，除为自身防护而购置手枪外，别无他意。顺便提及，数日前我家曾遭窃贼闯入，一笔款项被盗；且在此事件之前，已有多次企图闯入宅邸之事发生。如今我已婚配，深感有责任给予妻子一定的安全感，因为自最近这次盗窃案发生后，她一直惊恐不安。
相信阁下会惠予 favorable consideration（有利考量），
此致，
阁下顺从的仆人
N. S. Pokrovsky
俄籍翻译员。

（左侧批注：此事需予以95%的关注。恳切 / For upwards / 2 atm / 1932年4月21日）

S.A. (中央捕房)
Pokrovsky 先生并无手枪；警方
不能出售给他一支。其住宅
遭闯入这一事实，并不意味着
他应当拥有一支手枪以射杀窃贼，
因为他的工作并不危险，且与其他
人并无不同。上海有成千上万的外国人
并没有手枪
Stayers
1932年4月21日
DC (或)

C 5
请通知 Pokrovsky 先生
知悉。 N.S. Pokrovsky
1932年4月21日

No. D 3535.
Cr. & Sp. Br. Registry.
POLICE STATION;
April 19, 1932.

Application of (Rank Initials & Name) Translator N.A. Pokrovsky
that the Commissioner of Police will be pleased to allow the undersigned to
purchase a pistol or revolver from the Arms Section and the issue
of a free licence to carry.

Signature:— N.A. Pokrovsky.

Remarks of Chief Inspector, etc., i/c:
Forwarded & Recommended
Not recommended recent applications for special assistants to carry firearms have been refused there being no reasonable grounds for permission to allow them to be in possession of arms.
Signature:— 〔此处转录不清〕

Remarks of A. C. (F):—
Not Approved
(Sgd) 19/4/32
Signature:— 〔此处转录不清〕

D.I. Cole
please notify Mr Pokrovsky
〔此处转录不清〕 19/4/32.

Noted N.A. Pokrovsky
19.4.32.

Date: ____
Commissioner of Police.

申请人（职级、首字母及姓名） 翻译员 N.A. Pokrovsky
请求警务处处长恩准下述申请人
从军械科购买一支手枪或左轮手枪，并签发
免费持枪执照。

签名：— N.A. Pokrovsky。

总督察等主管官员意见：
转呈并推荐
不予推荐。近期特别助理人员携带枪支的申请均被拒绝，因无合理理由准许其持有武器。
签名：— 〔此处转录不清〕

不予批准
(签名) 1932年4月19日
